fusions.name: Lignum Ram
fusions.desc: A ram of dense, cold wood that deals 15 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Grain Splits
fusions.desc: Drives a spike of cold, dense heartwood into a target at or below 20% of its health, dealing 25 damage.

fusions.name: Grey Bark
fusions.desc: Your bark goes grey and cold: your armour rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Grain Gone Cold
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. You carry 6% frost resistance.
